positive: Exact Product/L2/Task DAG and accepted review/Claim evidence produces a deterministic diff and immutable PlanRevision.
Preserves accepted/terminal Tasks and unchanged unfinished work; supersession explicit.
Owner-approved current candidate can be activated only through selected K/Host source-bound effect and exact native readback.
Duplicate read/restart rehydrates revision history without lost accepted work or repeated external effects.
HTML/React model renders truthful pending/approved/blocked diff and never performs a privileged write.

negative.expected: Stale reviewed Product/PRD/L2 freezes refuse activation
Candidate computed at an old source HEAD cannot self-rebase authority
Cycle is rejected with witness and zero mutation
Previously accepted or terminal Task cannot be silently deleted or rewritten
Valid Claim/FSW bound to previous Task cannot be copied or reused
Competing live Writer on Business index/policy or parent worktree is denied/serialized
Advisory replan can render but cannot become an accepted DAG revision
No authorized new/revised Task Claim means zero provider/Host effect
Foreign source scope and GitHub target are rejected before any write
Duplicate key, WorkUnit alias, or conflicting Task revision is rejected
Unchanged unfinished work is preserved and traceable to prior revision
Revision mismatch or out-of-order update fails closed without overwrite
Uncertain write is reconciled via exact CAS/native readback; never blind retry
Rejected advisory PlanRevision has no activation and preserves last accepted baseline
Business-only projection does not fabricate a selected K/Host activation
Persisted immutable history reconstructed after restart; no duplicate effect
Self-report or login inequality alone does not qualify an independent source review
Client/view/form cannot call direct GitHub mutation or force approval state
Owner credentials/hidden tests/raw trace are absent from rendered diff and issue evidence
Missing task-meta/metrics stays UNKNOWN and does not block valid replan read
